moments.title: Senedd Backs Fair Funding for Wales
moments.blurb: Yesterday, October 12th, the Senedd backed a Plaid Cymru motion calling for fairer funding for Wales, including enhanced fiscal flexibilities and a review of the Barnett formula.

angles.name: Welsh Politics
angles.copy: Big news from the Senedd yesterday: cross-party support for fairer funding for Wales. A significant moment for the nation!

angles.name: Local Impact
angles.copy: The Senedd is demanding fairer funding for Wales. This could mean big changes for our communities. What do you think?

moments.title: Roman Fort Discovery in Pembrokeshire
moments.blurb: A newly identified Roman fort in Pembrokeshire, discovered on October 12th, could provide evidence for the long-held myth of Emperor Magnus Maximus's camp in Wales.

angles.name: Ancient Wales
angles.copy: Incredible discovery in Pembrokeshire! A Roman fort could prove a 4th-century emperor's camp in Wales was real. History in the making!

angles.name: Local History
angles.copy: Pembrokeshire is making headlines with a major Roman fort discovery that might just confirm ancient Welsh folklore. What a find!
